events.name: LoanApplicationSubmitted
events.trigger: PER-002 (or RM on behalf of customer) formally submits the loan application via the business portal or RM origination system. SVC-005 creates ENT-017 (LoanApplication) with status = submitted, assigns application_id, and publishes this event. The event is the boundary marker that commits the application to the formal origination workflow.
events.capability_scope_rationale: Published and primarily consumed within CAP-002 (SVC-005). EVT-032 (CreditAssessmentRequested) is the cross-capability event; this event remains within the commercial banking domain.

payload_schema.security_type: string enum (unsecured | fixed_charge_property | floating_charge_debenture | personal_guarantee | mixed)

events.payload_omissions: No financial statement content, director personal data, or credit scoring inputs in the payload. These remain in SVC-005 document store.

consumers.action: Internal workflow trigger: transitions LoanApplication to 'under_assessment' status; dispatches EVT-032 (CreditAssessmentRequested) to SVC-012. Notifies RM of successful submission.
Creates immutable audit record of loan application submission: application_id, business_customer_id, submitted_at. SMCR audit trail for the originating RM.
Sends application acknowledgement to PER-002 confirming application reference and indicative timescales.

events.ordering_guarantees: Per-application strict ordering via application_id partition key on topic commercial.loan-applications. All JRN-007 events for a given application_id are sequenced within the same partition.
events.worm_rationale: Contains business_customer_id and financial application data. Basel 3.1 audit requirements mandate retention of credit origination events. GOV-002-R01 (credit policy audit trail). Retained in SVC-111 for 7 years.

events.name: CreditAssessmentRequested
events.trigger: SVC-005 publishes this event immediately after LoanApplicationSubmitted processing. This is the cross-capability boundary event that initiates the automated credit scoring workflow in SVC-012 (Risk Engine, CAP-004). SVC-005 MUST NOT call SVC-012 synchronously — this async event is the only permitted communication mechanism across the CAP-002 / CAP-004 boundary.
events.capability_scope_rationale: Published by CAP-002 (SVC-005); consumed by CAP-004 (SVC-012 Risk Engine). This is a deliberate cross-capability async event per the architectural principle that cross-capability communication is exclusively async. SVC-012 must never receive synchronous API calls from SVC-005.

payload_schema.security_type: string enum (unsecured | fixed_charge_property | floating_charge_debenture | personal_guarantee | mixed)

events.payload_omissions: Does not include financial statements or unstructured documents — these are retrieved by SVC-012 from the document store via its own retrieval path using business_customer_id as the key.

consumers.action: Receives this event and initiates automated IRB credit scoring: computes PD (probability of default), LGD (loss given default), EAD (exposure at default), and ECL provision (IFRS 9). Creates ENT-018 (CreditAssessment) with initial automated scores. Publishes EVT-033 (CreditAssessmentCompleted) on completion.
Ingests the event for portfolio analytics — tracks new credit assessment requests by segment, sector, and period for commercial lending pipeline reporting.

events.ordering_guarantees: Per-application strict ordering via application_id partition key on topic commercial.credit-assessments. Guaranteed ordering relative to EVT-031 for the same application_id.
events.worm_rationale: Cross-capability credit request contains financial exposure data. Required for PRA IRB model audit trail and SMCR accountability for credit origination decisions.

events.name: CreditAssessmentCompleted
events.trigger: SVC-012 completes automated IRB scoring (PD/LGD/EAD/ECL) for the loan application. Creates ENT-018 (CreditAssessment) with all computed values and publishes this event. This is the return leg of the cross-capability credit assessment exchange — the async response to EVT-032. SVC-005 subscribes to this event to continue the origination workflow.
events.capability_scope_rationale: Published by CAP-004 (SVC-012 Risk Engine); consumed by CAP-002 (SVC-005 Commercial Banking Core). Return leg of the async credit assessment exchange. No synchronous call path exists from CAP-004 back to CAP-002.

payload_schema.assessment_id: string (UUID v4) — ENT-018 identifier in SVC-012
payload_schema.application_id: string (UUID v4) — correlation key to ENT-017
payload_schema.ead: number (decimal, 2 dp, GBP) — exposure at default
payload_schema.scoring_model_version: string — IRB model version identifier (PRA change notification reference)

events.payload_omissions: Does not include detailed model inputs, customer financial statements, or analyst commentary. Full CreditAssessment detail is accessible by SVC-005 via ENT-018 lookup using assessment_id.

consumers.action: Stores assessment_id reference on LoanApplication. Updates LoanApplication.status = under_assessment. Routes to Credit Analyst (PER-056) queue for manual credit paper preparation. If risk_rating >= 8, automatically flags for mandatory credit committee referral in PH-019.
Ingests credit assessment results for portfolio risk analytics: IRB parameter distributions, ECL provision forecasting, Basel 3.1 RWA calculation, IFRS 9 staging reports.
Logs assessment completion including model version — satisfies PRA IRB model audit trail requirement (PS17/23). SMCR evidence for the CRO's credit risk oversight function.

events.ordering_guarantees: Per-application strict ordering via application_id partition key on topic commercial.credit-assessments. Published by SVC-012 strictly after processing EVT-032 for the same application_id.
events.worm_rationale: Contains IRB risk parameters (PD, LGD, EAD) and ECL provision. PRA PS17/23 requires IRB model outputs to be immutably retained for model validation and supervisory examination. GOV-002-R01.

events.name: LoanApproved
events.trigger: Credit Committee (or RM within authority) records an approval decision in SVC-005. CreditAssessment.committee_decision transitions to 'approved' or 'approved_with_conditions'. LoanApplication.status transitions to 'approved'. SVC-005 publishes LoanApproved. If conditions precedent are outstanding, FacilityAgreement preparation begins but drawdown is blocked.
events.capability_scope_rationale: Published and consumed within CAP-002 (SVC-005). Triggers FacilityAgreement creation workflow (PH-020). Customer notification dispatched via SVC-053.

payload_schema.approved_amount: number (decimal, 2 dp, GBP) — may be less than requested_amount
payload_schema.approved_by: string (UUID v4) — staff_id of approving officer or committee identifier
payload_schema.conditions_precedent_count: integer — number of outstanding CPs (0 = unconditional)

consumers.action: Initiates FacilityAgreement (ENT-019) creation workflow. Assigns legal team for facility documentation. Updates LoanApplication.status = approved.
Dispatches loan approval letter to PER-002 with approved amount, indicative rate, and next steps. Includes standardised cost of credit disclosure (GOV-002-R05 APRC-equivalent).
Immutable audit record of credit approval decision. SMCR accountability evidence for the approving officer.

events.ordering_guarantees: Per-application strict ordering via application_id partition key on topic commercial.loan-applications.
events.worm_rationale: Credit approval decisions are core SMCR audit evidence. PRA examination can require production of the approval record for any credit in the commercial book. GOV-002-R01.

events.name: LoanDeclined
events.trigger: Credit Committee (or RM within authority) records a decline decision. CreditAssessment.committee_decision transitions to 'declined'. LoanApplication.status transitions to 'declined'. This is a terminal event for the application. Customer must be notified in writing with rationale (GOV-002-R05). Journey terminates at PH-019.
events.capability_scope_rationale: Published and consumed within CAP-002 (SVC-005). Terminal event — no further commercial lending events are published for this application_id.

payload_schema.decline_reasons: array<string> — standardised decline reason codes for regulatory reporting
payload_schema.decided_by: string (UUID v4) — staff_id of declining officer

consumers.action: Transitions LoanApplication.status = declined. Archives CreditAssessment. Unlocks RM to record alternative proposal or close the deal in the pipeline system.
Dispatches formal decline letter to PER-002 stating decline reasons and BBRS signposting (GOV-002-R03) and right of appeal. FCA SME lending rules require written notification.
Ingests decline event for portfolio analytics: decline rate by sector, risk rating, security type. Feeds commercial lending strategy reporting.
Immutable audit record of credit decline. GOV-002-R05 requires the bank to be able to evidence the decline rationale on demand.

events.ordering_guarantees: Per-application strict ordering via application_id partition key on topic commercial.loan-applications.
events.worm_rationale: Credit decline decisions require retention for FOS/BBRS dispute resolution and GOV-002-R05 regulatory evidence.

events.name: FacilityAgreed
events.trigger: PER-002 executes the facility agreement (physical or ETDA-compliant electronic signature). SVC-005 records FacilityAgreement.signed_date and confirms all conditions precedent are either satisfied or have been formally waived. LoanApplication.status transitions to 'facility_agreed'. FacilityAgreed is published, enabling the drawdown workflow (PH-021).
events.capability_scope_rationale: Published and consumed within CAP-002 (SVC-005). This event gates drawdown — SVC-005 will not process a drawdown instruction without a confirmed FacilityAgreed event for the same application_id.

consumers.action: Unlocks drawdown processing for PH-021. Creates the LoanAccount (ENT-020) record in pending status, ready to activate on drawdown. Notifies RM that drawdown can now be instructed.
Immutable audit record of facility execution. Legal documentation audit trail.

events.ordering_guarantees: Per-application strict ordering via application_id partition key on topic commercial.loan-applications.
events.worm_rationale: Executed facility agreements are legal contracts. WORM retention required for the full loan term plus 7 years for limitation period coverage.

events.name: LoanDrawnDown
events.trigger: PER-002 submits a drawdown instruction for some or all of the approved facility. SVC-005 validates: (a) FacilityAgreed received, (b) all conditions precedent satisfied, (c) drawdown amount <= remaining undrawn facility. SVC-005 instructs SVC-009 (Domestic Payments Service) to credit the drawdown amount to BusinessAccount (ENT-080) via CHAPS (same-day) or BACS. On settlement confirmation, SVC-005 updates LoanAccount.outstanding_balance and publishes LoanDrawnDown.
events.capability_scope_rationale: Initiates a cross-capability interaction with CAP-003 (SVC-009 Domestic Payments Service) to execute the drawdown payment to the business account. The payment execution itself is handled by CAP-003; SVC-005 publishes LoanDrawnDown after receiving settlement confirmation.

consumers.action: Updates LoanAccount.outstanding_balance, sets drawdown_date, transitions LoanAccount.status = active. Schedules first repayment date. Activates covenant monitoring schedule per FacilityAgreement.covenants.

Subscribes to update portfolio-level EAD and RWA calculations in the Basel 3.1 capital model. Updates the IFRS 9 ECL provision for the drawn exposure. This is an async update — SVC-012 does not gate the drawdown.
Ingests drawdown event for lending portfolio reporting: drawn balances by segment, sector, security type, risk rating.
Dispatches drawdown confirmation letter to PER-002 with drawdown amount, first repayment date, and repayment schedule.

events.ordering_guarantees: Per-account strict ordering via account_id partition key on topic commercial.loan-accounts. Published strictly after settlement confirmation from SVC-009.
events.worm_rationale: Drawdown is a financial transaction triggering capital and IFRS 9 reporting. PRA Basel 3.1 RWA audit trail. Retained in SVC-111 for 7 years.

events.name: LoanAccountOpened
events.trigger: SVC-005 publishes LoanAccountOpened immediately after LoanDrawnDown on first drawdown, confirming that the LoanAccount record is active and the loan is on the commercial ledger. This event initiates the ongoing monitoring workflow (PH-022) in SVC-005.
events.capability_scope_rationale: Published by CAP-002 (SVC-005). Consumed within CAP-002 to initiate PH-022 monitoring. Also consumed by SVC-012 for portfolio-level capital calculations.

payload_schema.covenant_count: integer — number of financial covenants to monitor

consumers.action: Activates covenant monitoring schedule (PH-022). Creates the initial CovenantMonitoring (ENT-021) records in 'not_yet_tested' status for each covenant in FacilityAgreement.covenants. Adds loan to annual review queue.
Adds the loan to the active credit portfolio register. Sets up periodic IFRS 9 ECL re-assessment schedule. Updates Basel 3.1 RWA register.
Ingests the new loan account opening for commercial lending portfolio reporting and financial planning.

events.ordering_guarantees: Published immediately after EVT-037 for the same first drawdown. Per-account strict ordering via account_id partition key on topic commercial.loan-accounts.
events.worm_rationale: Loan account opening is a regulated financial event. Basel 3.1 and IFRS 9 both require the loan inception record to be immutably retained.

events.name: CovenantBreachDetected
events.trigger: SVC-005 completes a periodic covenant test (PH-022) and the actual_value fails the covenant threshold: actual_value < target_value for minimum covenants (e.g. DSCR below floor) or actual_value > target_value for maximum covenants (e.g. leverage above cap). CovenantMonitoring.compliance_status transitions to 'breached'. LoanAccount.status transitions to 'watch_list' (pending formal default declaration). EVT-039 is published to initiate the RM/Credit Analyst escalation workflow.
events.capability_scope_rationale: Published within CAP-002 (SVC-005). Consumed by SVC-005 for escalation and by SVC-012 for IFRS 9 staging reassessment. The breach may trigger re-scoring in SVC-012 via an additional CreditAssessmentRequested event.

payload_schema.covenant_type: string enum (dscr_min | leverage_max | interest_cover_min | tangible_net_worth_min | other)
payload_schema.breach_magnitude_pct: number (decimal, 2 dp) — percentage by which actual deviates from target

consumers.action: Transitions LoanAccount.status = watch_list. Assigns to RM queue for borrower contact. Triggers credit committee referral for waiver consideration. Notifies credit analyst for updated credit paper. May trigger re-assessment request (EVT-032) if material breach warrants IFRS 9 stage migration.

On receipt of covenant breach, re-assesses IFRS 9 staging: evaluates whether the breach constitutes a Significant Increase in Credit Risk (SICR) requiring Stage 2 (lifetime ECL) or Stage 3 (credit-impaired) classification. Updates ECL provision accordingly.
Sends internal notification to RM (PER-050) and Credit Analyst (PER-056) of the covenant breach. External customer notification is handled separately after RM review (not automated on detection).
Immutable audit record of covenant breach detection. Required for BBRS dispute resolution evidence (GOV-002-R03) and PRA supervisory examination.

events.ordering_guarantees: Per-account strict ordering via loan_account_id partition key on topic commercial.covenant-monitoring.
events.worm_rationale: Covenant breach is a material credit event. Required for BBRS dispute resolution, PRA examination, and IFRS 9 impairment evidence. GOV-002-R01, GOV-002-R03.
